title: Vámonos a Mundo Nuevo heritage experience
summary: Explore a heritage museum, gardens, an estate greenhouse and chocolate-making experiences on this full-day outing.
description: The National Trust's full-day Mundo Nuevo experience is scheduled for Saturday, October 3, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The advertised programme includes the Mundo Nuevo Heritage Museum, an estate walk and greenhouse, a garden visit, and chocolate-making, wine and sampling experiences. Tickets are TT$275 for non-members and TT$225 for members; lunch is an optional TT$60 extra. Confirm transport, meeting point, age requirements and availability with the organizer.
